name: Reader
summary: Browser study companion that reads university PDFs aloud with on-device OCR and speech synthesis.
description: Upload course PDFs, lecture notes or scanned handouts and Reader turns them into a reflowable reading view with synchronized text-to-speech, adjustable speed, sentence highlighting and Sepia or Dark reading themes. PDF parsing, OCR and speech all run in the browser, so the files stay on the device with no account, upload or fee.
contains: reads course PDFs aloud with the browser's speech synthesis
client-side OCR for scanned photocopied handouts
playback 0.5x to 2.0x with sentence highlighting and paragraph hopping
Sepia and Dark reading themes, adjustable font size and line height
documents stay on device (IndexedDB); no accounts, subscriptions or tracking
free and open source under PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0
